name: Doukyonin wa Wanko
source:
She lived her way in her bachelorette apartment. Just she and her pet dog, Toma.

One day she came home to a strange man in her room, who explained he was the very same dog.

It was absurd, and only half-believingly she let him stay. So begins her life with a "roommate."

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138453.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她独自住在单身公寓里，陪伴她的只有宠物狗托马。

一天回家时，她发现房间里有个陌生男人。男人解释说，自己就是那条狗。

这太荒唐了，她半信半疑地让他留了下来。她与“室友”的生活就此开始。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE138453.html]DLsite English[/url]]
